content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Midland

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's formal requirements and gather documentation of your background before applying—this step ensures you meet the credential's foundation.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Our online format fits working professionals' schedules across Midland's energy, construction, healthcare, and public-sector industries. You'll cover the PMBOK® Guide, exam domains, and real-world scenarios in real time with active certified practitioners.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the 35-hour course, submit your PMP application directly to PMI with proof of education and experience. Pay the required exam fee to secure your test date. PMI will verify your credentials before authorizing you to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor review sessions—to strengthen your mastery of PMP domains. Schedule your computer-based exam through PMI's testing partner and complete the assessment on your chosen date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP is valid for three years. Maintain it by earning professional development units (PDUs) through ongoing training, certifications, volunteer work, or conference attendance. Renew your credential before expiration to keep your competitive advantage in Midland's project-driven sectors.
